## megalinter-reports/updated_sources/.owlbear/briefs/draft-browser-knowledge-extraction/synthesis.md
- # `Synthesis — Authenticated Content Pipeline`
- ## `Convergences`
- ### `1. Browser CDP Is the Correct Extraction Mechanism`
- ### `2. Separate Browser Package, Protocol-Based Integration`
- ### `3. User Approval Is the Primary Source-Scope Control`
- ### `4. New Entity Types via Direct Enum Extension`
- ### `5. Content Safety: IDPI + Untrusted Wrapping Required Before Go-Live`
- ### `6. Discovery and Extraction Are Separate Phases`
- ### `7. Fail-Fast on Authentication Failure`
- ### `8. Pre-Flight Validation Before Every Extraction Run`
- ### `9. Phased Delivery`
- ## `Disagreements`
- ### `D1. HTML Cleaning Must Precede Any Ingestion (Data) vs. Phase 1 Scope (Architect)`
- ### `D2. Browser MCP Tool Surface: Read-Only vs. Interactive (Security vs. Architect/End-User)`
- ### `D3. Unmanaged "One-Time Extract" Mode (End-User — Unaddressed by Others)`
- ### `D4. URL Guard Enforcement Layer (Security vs. Architect)`
- ### `D5. Refresh-Time Auto-Inclusion of New Pages (End-User vs. Security Implicit)`
- ### `D6. Entity Metadata Propagation (Data — Unaddressed by Others)`
- ## `Approach Options`
- ### `Option A: Pipeline-First — Fix Quality Gaps, Then Add Browser`
- ### `Option B: Infrastructure-First — Browser + Source Type, Then Quality Hardening`
- ### `Option C: Parallel Tracks — Browser Infrastructure + Pipeline Quality Simultaneously`
- ### `Option D: Minimal Viable Pipeline — Browser + Cleaning + Hash, Defer Canonicalization and Discovery`
- ## `Recommendation`
- ## `Open Questions`

- ### `VF-3: Tailwind is NOT installed and NOT required`
- ### `VF-4: tokens.css creates a parallel shadow namespace`
- ### `VF-5: PDS light-dark() eliminates manual theme overrides`
- ## `Candidate Implications`
- ### `CI-1: Root-cause-first hypothesis is strongly supported`
- ### `CI-2: Tailwind integration is PDS-recommended and should be adopted`
- ### `CI-3: Component migration scope depends on post-foundation audit`
- ### `CI-4: Builder visual feedback is a process risk, not a scope risk`
- ## `Open Research Questions`
- ### `ORQ-1: What happens to existing PDS components when tokens.css is removed?`
- ### `ORQ-2: Does PDS `PorscheDesignSystemProvider` handle theme switching without tokens.css?`
- ### `ORQ-3: What's the migration path for `--pds-*` references?`
- ### `ORQ-4: How does PDS `light-dark()` interact with the existing `useTheme` hook?`

- ## `Convergences`
- ### `Direction: Replace kanban-md with native Python engine`
- ### `Placement: `serve/kanban-engine/` as a shared dependency`
- ### `Lossless YAML round-trip for unknown fields`
- ### `Atomic file writes via temp + `os.replace()``
- ### `Frontmatter `id` as canonical identity (not filename)`
- ### `Duplicate frontmatter IDs are a hard error`
- ### `Slug frozen at creation; no file rename on title edit`
- ### `activity.jsonl format preservation`
- ### `Session-stable claim identity`
- ### `Config statuses as objects, not flat strings`
- ### `Timestamps as strings in the API model`
- ### `YAML safe loading is non-negotiable`
- ### `Path containment within the board directory`
- ### `Migration order: engine first, then MCP, then orchestrator, then cleanup`
- ### `Canonical `TaskRecord` model`
- ## `Disagreements`
- ### `1. YAML library — PyYAML vs ruamel.yaml`
- ### `2. Concurrency / locking strategy`
- ### `3. Additional dependencies beyond pydantic + stdlib`
- ### `4. Compound operations (start_work / end_work) — engine or consumer?`
- ### `5. YAML resource limits (billion-laughs protection)`
- ### `6. Timestamp resolver disabling`
- ## `Recommendation`
- ## `Open Questions`

- ### `F3: Access control env var never configured`
- ### `F4: The file-based path IS the working system`
- ### `F5: Current tool descriptions are terse but not wrong`
- ### `F6: Tool annotation hints are correctly set`
- ### `F7: Pipeline protocol's confidence recommendation (0.8) differs from model minimum (0.7)`
- ### `F8: Two pipeline agents DO have ob-memory/* already`
- ## `Candidate Implications`
- ### `I1: The brief is effectively a "first real deployment" of the MCP memory system`
- ### `I2: The consumer migration (P2) is actually the activation of a dormant system`
- ### `I3: The curator agent needs both file-based AND MCP tools`
- ### `I4: Tool surface redesign can be bolder because there's no production usage to migrate FROM`
- ### `I5: The `h-mcp-memory` skill already documents much of what's missing from tool descriptions`

- ## `Convergences`
- ### `1. VS Code extension + Moonshine STT subprocess is the correct architecture`
- ### `2. No existing drop-in tool meets all constraints`
- ### `3. Editor buffers via `TextEditor.edit()` are the proven, correct insertion target`
- ### `4. Existing v2 STT code (SttRunner, Moonshine, VAD) is directly reusable`
- ### `5. TTS, brainstorm mode, and askQuestions are correctly out of scope`
- ### `6. Windows STT latency must be empirically validated before committing`
- ### `7. Push-to-talk as the default activation model`
- ### `8. First-run experience requires explicit handling`
- ### `9. Audio stack on corporate Windows is a hard environmental dependency`
- ## `Disagreements`
- ### `D1: Copilot Chat as an initial deployment target`
- ### `D2: Push-to-talk mechanism — hold vs. toggle`
- ### `D3: Scope of security prerequisites before engineering begins`
- ### `D4: Transcript leakage in existing code`
- ### `D5: TTS dependency removal`
- ## `Recommendation`
- ## `Open Questions`

## megalinter-reports/updated_sources/.owlbear/briefs/kanban-mcp-surface-v2/synthesis.md
- # `Synthesis — Brief A: MCP Tool Surface`
- ## `1. Convergences`
- ## `2. Disagreements`
- ### `D1. Tool count: 9 vs 10 — `list_sessions``
- ### `D2. Section param: singular vs plural`
- ### `D3. `archival_ref` — required vs optional, type, forbidden-when rules`
- ### `D4. Batch-create intra-batch dependencies`
- ### `D5. `list_tasks` `archived` param — keep vs drop`
- ### `D6. `end_work` archive-reject path`
- ### `D7. `edit_task` on archived tasks — mutable vs immutable`
- ### `D8. `create_tasks` return type`
- ### `D9. Projection naming: `KanbanTask` vs `TaskFull``
- ## `3. Recommended Resolution`
- ### `D1. `list_sessions` → **Defer (side with End-User)**`
- ### `D2. Section param → **Singular `section` (side with Architect), but adopt `missing_sections` signaling from End-User**`
- ### `D3. `archival_ref` → **Required for deprecated/duplicate, forbidden otherwise (side with End-User), but keep `int` type (side with Architect)**`
- ### `D4. Batch-create intra-batch deps → **No intra-batch deps (side with Architect)**`
- ### `D5. `list_tasks` `archived` param → **Drop it (side with End-User)**`
- ### `D6. `end_work` archive-reject → **Add it (side with End-User)**`
- ### `D7. `edit_task` on archived tasks → **Allow archival metadata correction (side with End-User)**`
- ### `D8. `create_tasks` return type → **`TaskSummary[]` (side with Architect)**`
- ### `D9. Projection naming → **`TaskFull` (side with Architect)**`
- ## `4. Open Decisions for the Mediator`
- ### `Q1. `list_sessions` — in Brief A or follow-up?`
- ### `Q2. Multi-section projection — accept the V2 gap?`
- ### `Q3. `archival_ref` strictness — required or optional for deprecated/duplicate?`
- ## `5. Final Recommended Surface`
- ### `Tool List`
- ### `Projection Schemas`
- #### `TaskSummary (list operations, batch create)`
- #### `TaskFull (single-task operations)`
- #### `DispatchEntry (pick_tasks)`
- ### ``archival_reason` Enum`
- ### ``completed` Gating`
- ### `Legacy Archived Tasks`
- ## `Confidence`

- # `Cockpit Visual Audit — Comprehensive Synthesis`
- ## `Executive Summary`
- ## `0. Root Cause: PDS Foundation Not Installed`
- ### `F-0.1 Missing required PDS stylesheet imports (CRITICAL)`
- ### `F-0.2 Custom token system duplicates PDS with wrong prefix`
- ### `F-0.3 Tailwind CSS integration not configured`
- ### `Remediation direction`
- ## `1. Board Layout`
- ### `F-1.1 Columns wrap into multi-row grid instead of horizontal scroll (CRITICAL)`
- ### `F-1.2 Board layout is entirely inline styles`
- ### `F-1.3 Board toolbar is unstyled`
- ### `F-1.4 Loading state is a bare `<div>``
- ### `F-1.5 Error state is a bare `<div>``
- ## `2. Status Bar`
- ### `F-2.1 No visible application identity`
- ### `F-2.2 Traffic-light span is invisible`
- ### `F-2.3 Task count span is always empty`
- ### `F-2.4 All status bar actions look identical`
- ### `F-2.5 HealthBadge popover is in-flow (expands header)`
- ### `F-2.6 DRStatusIndicator popover is in-flow (expands header)`
- ### `F-2.7 CleanupPanel confirms inline in status bar`
- ### `F-2.8 ThemeToggle is a raw `<button>` with custom class`
- ## `3. Sidecar (Worst Area)`
- ### `F-3.1 Sidecar has zero internal padding`
- ### `F-3.2 Collapse button is a raw `<button>` with custom class`
- ### `F-3.3 Task heading is unstyled`
- ### `F-3.4 Tabs use raw web components, not React wrappers`
- ### `F-3.5 Decision request list is raw `<ul><li>` with bullet points`
- ### `F-3.6 Detail metadata has no layout structure`
- ### `F-3.7 Raw data shown to user`
- ### `F-3.8 "Actions" section is unstyled`
- ### `F-3.9 Edit fields have no section grouping`
- ### `F-3.10 Body text is unstyled`
- ### `F-3.11 No dividers between sections`
- ### `F-3.12 "History" button floats randomly`
- ## `4. Cards`
- ### `F-4.1 Cards show almost no metadata`
- ### `F-4.2 Card title truncation is too aggressive`
- ### `F-4.3 Card chips are too small (0.72rem = ~11.5px)`
- ### `F-4.4 Undefined CSS variables in Card.css`
- ### `F-4.5 State cue chips have no icons`
- ## `5. Columns`
- ### `F-5.1 Column headers are too small (0.8125rem = 13px)`
- ### `F-5.2 Empty states are minimal`
- ### `F-5.3 Column body gap too tight (4px)`
- ### `F-5.4 Scrollable column bodies not keyboard-accessible`
- ### `F-5.5 Status names expose internal API strings`
- ## `6. Filter Panel`
- ### `F-6.1 Filter toggle is a raw `<button>``
- ### `F-6.2 `PSelect` uses raw `<option>` children instead of `<PSelectOption>``
- ### `F-6.3 Blocked filter is a raw checkbox`
- ### `F-6.4 Filter panel pushes board content down`
- ### `F-6.5 Filter panel has excessive internal whitespace`
- ### `F-6.6 No "Clear all filters" button`
- ## `7. Context Menu`
- ### `F-7.1 Menu items are unstyled text`
- ### `F-7.2 "Archive" action not differentiated as destructive`
- ## `8. Modals & Overlays`
- ### `F-8.1 ArchivalModal uses custom overlay, not PDS `PModal``
- ### `F-8.2 ResolveModal uses custom overlay, not PDS `PModal``
- ### `F-8.3 ConfirmDialog uses custom overlay, not PDS `PModal``
- ### `F-8.4 All overlays use JS-computed positioning`
- ## `9. Dark Mode`
- ### `F-9.1 Cards and columns have no visible borders in dark mode`
- ### `F-9.2 Column count badges barely visible in dark mode`
- ### `F-9.3 Status bar buttons maintain light-mode border style`
- ### `F-9.4 Sidecar has no border differentiation in dark mode`
- ## `10. Typography`
- ### `F-10.1 No PDS type scale in use`
- ### `F-10.2 No heading hierarchy`
- ### `F-10.3 PText used without size/weight props`
- ### `F-10.4 No Porsche Next font loaded`
